description: This Jupyter Notebook implements the backend inference pipeline for Model B, including loading model artifacts, performing segmentation, detecting sponge zones, generating GeoJSON outputs, and saving results. It is designed to be compatible with the FastAPI backend endpoints for terrain segmentation and sponge-zone detection, and it uses the same functions as the API for consistency.

classes.name: ModelBArtifacts
classes.description: Dataclass holding the loaded model, meta information, and constants used for inference.

classes.name: SpongeZoneConstants
classes.description: Constants used for sponge zone detection, potentially overriding defaults.

methods.name: load_model_b_onnx
methods.description: Loads the ONNX model and associated metadata for inference.

methods.name: predict_segmentation
methods.description: Runs segmentation inference on the input image bytes.

methods.name: detect_sponge_zones
methods.description: Identifies sponge zones from the segmentation mask using connected component analysis.

methods.name: sponge_zones_to_geojson
methods.description: Converts sponge zones to a GeoJSON FeatureCollection with pixel-coordinate polygons.
